annotations.title: Register this computer as an organisation node

description: Register THIS MACHINE as a Capsule node of the organisation — so "this machine is guarded" is something the organisation can verify, not only the user. One node per machine; every agent here (Claude Code, Cursor …) is a workload on it; billing stays per decision, a node is not a billing unit. Uses the Capsule agent's own enrolment and signed heartbeat. The heartbeat reports only: a machine id (a salted hash, never the host name), the agents' names, whether the read gate is on, and the accepted terms version — never content. ASKS FIRST: without confirm:true it shows the status, or what registering would send. Call with confirm:true only after the user approves.

confirm.description: true = register this machine. Omit to see status / preview.
